title: Power Apps: automatic loading and numbered pages in the modern Data Grid
summary: The roadmap facts, maker settings and documented pagination behaviour are supported. One descriptive claim needs narrowing: Learn does not say that changing Items clears search and sorting. Minor corrections should clarify search setup and the distinction between unpublished pagination-specific charges and existing app licensing.

claims.claim: This change concerns maker configuration of the modern Data Grid in canvas apps.
claims.quote: Makers can configure the modern Data Grid in canvas apps to load more records automatically as users scroll or display numbered pages with a configurable page size.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Built-in search over a partly loaded source can return incomplete results.
claims.quote: Built-in search over a partly loaded source can return incomplete results.

claims.where: Why it matters
claims.claim: No match among loaded records does not establish that the remote table has no matching records.
claims.quote: A search with no matches among loaded records doesn't prove that the remote table has no matches.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The grid's Items formula supplies its data source.
claims.quote: **Items** – The data source for the grid. Accepts a Dataverse table, collection, or inline table expression.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Built-in search checks loaded records when DelegateSearch is false.
claims.quote: When **DelegateSearch** is `false`, search checks the grid's loaded records.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; writer evidence: DelegateSearch
claims.claim: With DelegateSearch true, the grid exposes SearchText instead of applying its own search filter.
claims.quote: When `true`, the grid exposes **SearchText** without applying its own search filter; use that output in the **Items** formula.

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout, source-wide search; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Source-wide search requires DelegateSearch true and a delegable Items filter.
claims.quote:
1. Set **Searchable** to `true`.
2. Set **DelegateSearch** to `true`.
3. Use the grid's **SearchText** output in **Items** with a filter that your connector can delegate.
claims.fix: Replace the At rollout search bullet with: 'For source-wide search, have makers set Searchable and DelegateSearch to true, then use the grid's SearchText output in Items with a filter their connector can delegate.' This carries the complete documented setup rather than implying any Items filter is sufficient.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Changing Items, Pagination or PageSize rebuilds paging, so a page number cannot be relied on afterwards.
claims.quote: Changing the paging configuration rebuilds the paging view. Don't depend on a page number remaining unchanged after changing **Items**, **Pagination**, or **PageSize**.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: CurrentPage, ItemsCount and AllItemsLoaded are outputs and should not receive formulas to implement paging.
claims.quote: **CurrentPage**, **ItemsCount**, and **AllItemsLoaded** are outputs. Don't assign formulas to them to implement custom paging.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: ItemsCount counts loaded records rather than the remote data source's total.
claims.quote: **ItemsCount** – The number of records currently loaded by the grid, not the total record count in the remote data source and not just the number of rows on the visible page.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support

claims.quote: The app checker flags columns with text wrapping enabled.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A pagination-specific licence or meter has not been published, so the feature's licensing model is unknown.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps Data Grid pagination licensing license meter; "Data Grid" "Pagination" "license". Opened Data Grid and Power Platform licensing FAQs; no pagination-specific licence or meter found. The FAQs do document underlying canvas-app licensing.
claims.fix: Keep licensing.model unknown but narrow the prose and licensing notes to 'No pagination-specific licence, price or meter is documented at the time of writing (November 2026); the app's existing Power Apps licensing requirements still apply.' Change the licensing open question to 'Will Microsoft publish any additional licence or meter for pagination?' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/powerapps-flow-licensing-faq for existing app licensing.

claims.quote: The canvas grid also checks the shared **AI insight cards** (`EnableFormInsights`) setting and whether AI prompts are enabled. Allowing the canvas-specific feature doesn't override these settings or license and capacity eligibility checks.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Modern controls and themes are enabled per canvas app through Settings > Updates > New > Modern controls and themes.
claims.quote:
With your canvas app open for editing:
1. On the command bar, select **Settings** > **Updates**.
2. Select the **New** tab and then turn on **Modern controls and themes**.

claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps modern controls themes setting enable API PowerShell pac admin Dataverse; modern controls Power Platform API; modern controls administration PowerShell. Opened modern-controls overview; no equivalent automation found.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: An app's nondelegable query row limit is configured through Settings > General > Data row limit.
claims.quote:
The default number of records is 500, but you can change this number for your app:
1. Select **Settings**.
2. Under **General**, change the **Data row limit** setting from 1 to 10,000.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Open questions
